title: Stroke predicted effector genes (Mishra A et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Stroke genetics informs drug discovery and risk prediction across ancestries.
Mishra A, Malik R, Hachiya T et al.
Nature. 2022 Nov;611(7934):115-123. doi: 10.1038/s41586-022-05165-3.
PMID: 36180795

The authors performed a GWAS meta-analysis of incident stroke and its sub-types in a multi-ethnic population of 110,182 stroke patients and 1,503,898 control individuals. They then applied a variety of bioinformatic approaches to prioritize potential causal genes at the genome-wide significant loci from the inverse-variance weighted meta-analysis using METAL. Mouse over a column header to see an explanation of its contents.
